annotations.title: Confirm a request with its code

description: Finish a request that sirfus_request_pro answered with needsConfirm: Sirfus sent a 6-digit code to the phone or email the person gave, and no business hears about the request until it is confirmed. Ask the person for the code and pass it with the confirmId. Returns the ticket, like sirfus_request_pro.
name: sirfus_confirm_request
title: Confirm a request with its code
